A.meaning: The tool-argument contract refused the call; the mutation body never ran.
A.name: TOOL_SCHEMA

sources.FRAMEWORK_TOOL_ERROR: any other ToolNode error message (status=error) not produced by the tool itself
sources.FRAMEWORK_UNKNOWN_TOOL: the model named a tool that does not exist; ToolNode answers, no LCSP code ran before this change
sources.FRAMEWORK_UNPARSEABLE_ARGUMENTS: the model's tool-call arguments were not valid JSON; the call never executes and the model receives no tool answer
sources.TOOL_PREFLIGHT: the tool wrapper's JSON-schema check (missing/mistyped/unknown/duplicate/out-of-enum arguments)

B.meaning: The body ran and refused a semantic precondition before touching the draft.
B.name: AUTHORING_PRECONDITION

C.meaning: The authored draft exists and the Compliance Rule Set validator executes. A different event family (RULE_VALIDATION_STARTED/PASSED/FAILED); never an authoring rejection.
C.name: REAL_RULE_VALIDATION

persistence.checkpointing: the Preparation graph is built with checkpointer=False and is claim-once: nothing resumes an in-flight run after a process restart. 'Restart' in tests means a rebuilt graph over live run state.
persistence.draft: in-process run context (context.draft); not persisted API-side before submission
persistence.rejections: published as durable stream events (RULE_AUTHORING_TOOL_REJECTED with a sanitized envelope; RULE_AUTHORING_REJECTION_RESOLVED when it ends) and kept in context.rejection_log (last 200)

constraints: READY -> RULE_AUTHORING via the API AUTHOR_RULES operation; idempotent afterwards
tools.description: Transition the same Agent from frozen inventory ready to Rule authoring against that revision.
tools.name: start_rule_authoring

offset.description: Zero-based start; negative values start at 0

constraints: limit<1 or missing -> 20, >20 capped to 20, negative offset -> 0; reported as requestedLimit/appliedLimit; never rejected for size
tools.description: Read exact claims (statement, actor/action, provenance), relations, unaccounted claims or Requirements, one bounded page at a time. The reply states requestedLimit, appliedLimit, offset, returnedCount, hasMore and nextOffset; a page size above 20 is capped at 20 and reported, never rejected. Use claim_id to fetch one exact claim.
tools.name: get_claim_inventory

constraints: normal path exposes only verified operative anchors; retrieve their closure before authoring; pages of at most 40
tools.description: Choose verified LEGAL_NORMATIVE operative anchors from the frozen inventory, then call get_semantic_closure to obtain compatible bindings and exact authoringArguments. This normal path does not expose a global role pool. Global get_claim_inventory remains diagnostic/navigation only. Pages of at most 40 with explicit cursors.
tools.name: get_rule_authoring_context

constraints: typed projection around compatible verified normative operative anchors; exact authoringArguments retain every reachable modifier and context
tools.description: Read the verified typed semantic closure of one operative anchor or a compatible operative aggregation. Only reachable applicability, qualifications, exceptions, temporal branches, definitions and context may bind its Requirement.
tools.name: get_semantic_closure

constraints: exact unique quotation resolves against pinned AST UTF-16 coordinates and content hash; no law interpretation
tools.description: Resolve a unique exact minimal quotation against pinned AST content and return immutable UTF-16 offsets and SHA-256. This locates text only; independent audit decides entailment.
tools.name: get_source_support

constraints: projection of Requirements, AssessmentRules, unbound claims, unresolved rejections and next valid actions; not a second authority
tools.description: Bounded read-only projection of Rule authoring progress: the exact IDs and titles of your authored Requirements (assessable or not, with or without an AssessmentRule), your AssessmentRules, unbound relevant claims by role, any unresolved rejection of your last mutation and the next valid actions. Use it to get the exact legalRequirementId values author_assessment_rule needs. Not a second authority
tools.name: get_rule_authoring_status

constraints: every claim ID must exist in the frozen V3 inventory and be RELEVANT (INTENTIONALLY_NON_OPERATIVE claims cannot be bound)
begin with compatible LEGAL_NORMATIVE operative anchors; every binding must belong to their verified typed semantic closures; guidance is never an operative anchor

a claim's accounting role is projected from its verified semantic closure and must match the argument it is supplied in: operative_claim_ids=DUTY|PROHIBITION|PERMISSION; applicability_claim_ids=SCOPE|CONDITION only; qualifier_claim_ids=QUALIFIER|TEMPORAL_RULE|TRANSITION_RULE; exception_claim_ids=EXCEPTION; context_claim_ids=CONTEXT|CROSS_REFERENCE|DEFINITION
operative_claim_ids must be non-empty (declared minItems 1; the body returns the richer OPERATIVE_PROPOSITION_REQUIRED with candidates)
an assessable Requirement needs at least one applicability claim unless non_assessable_reason is given
the assembled Requirement row must satisfy the packet schema
tools.description: Bind selected frozen claim IDs to exact Requirement roles. Canonical actor/action/text/provenance and coverage-state shape are assembled from those claims. A non-assessable reason means external/non-repository performance, not a substitute software duty.
tools.idempotencyKey: requirement_key; an identical resend leaves the draft fingerprint and revision unchanged, different content under the same key replaces the row (+1 draft revision)
tools.mutation: adds or replaces context.draft.legalRequirements[requirement_key]; re-derives contextRelations; invalidates any cached validation
tools.name: author_legal_requirement

constraints: legal_requirement_ids must name existing ASSESSABLE Requirements (COVERED_BY_ASSESSMENT_RULES); a non-assessable or unknown parent is ORPHAN_ASSESSMENT_RULE
criteria, applicability and evidence are derived by the API from the parents; investigation_focus is a non-normative suggestion
tools.description: Choose assessable Requirement parents. API derives normative criteria, applicability and evidence from those parents; optional investigation focus cannot create a legal obligation.
tools.name: author_assessment_rule

constraints: candidate_id must exist in the draft section selected by kind; removing a Requirement also removes AssessmentRules that cite it
tools.description: Remove a mistaken downstream candidate, recording why. Removing a Requirement invalidates its dependent AssessmentRule candidates; frozen claims stay unchanged.
tools.idempotencyKey: candidate_id (a second removal of the same id is rejected: UNKNOWN_CANDIDATE)
tools.mutation: the only operation that can lower the Requirement count
tools.name: remove_rule_candidate

constraints: requires a frozen inventory and a reason; increments the inventory revision and clears the whole draft
tools.description: Explicitly reopen discovery for a reason, increment revision, remap claim identities and invalidate ALL downstream candidates. Previous frozen revision stays immutable.
tools.mutation: resets context.draft and every unresolved authoring rejection (phase change)
tools.name: reopen_semantic_claim_inventory

constraints: runs the real Rule validator on the exact draft; the ONLY operation that increments rule_validation_attempt
tools.description: Validate current Rule candidates against the frozen inventory revision, returning grouped claim/provenance/fidelity gaps. No arguments or replacement packet. A pass enters SUBMISSION_READY without publishing authority.
tools.mutation: last_validation; phase SUBMISSION_READY on PASS else RULE_AUTHORING
tools.name: validate_compliance_rule_set

constraints: only after validation PASSED for the exact draft; idempotent per run
tools.description: Explicitly submit the exact validated frozen-inventory draft once through the Completion Gate. No arguments or replacement packet.
tools.mutation: persists the Rule Set through the API
tools.name: submit_compliance_rule_set
